title: Mobile release on Friday
transcript:
[00:00] Nadia: Marketing booked the app store feature for this weekend. They want version 3 out on Friday.
[00:07] Theo: The offline mode still crashes on older Android phones.
[00:11] Ruben: And App Store review has been taking two days lately.
[00:16] Nadia: I know. Can we make Friday?
[00:20] Theo: Sure, Friday, what could go wrong.
[00:24] Ruben: Ha. I'll prep the store listing either way.
[00:28] Nadia: Great, I'll tell marketing Friday is on.
[00:32] Theo: I'll keep working the crash.
[00:36] Ruben: Screenshots are done, by the way. Just need the release notes.
[00:41] Nadia: I'll write those today.

expectedDecisions.statement: Version 3 of the mobile app ships on Friday.
quotes: Sure, Friday, what could go wrong.
I'll tell marketing Friday is on.
I'll prep the store listing either way.

expectedDecisions.statement: Nadia writes the release notes today.

readings.reading: Submitted for review in time to be live on Friday 6 November, for the weekend feature.
Not Friday. Realistically Wednesday 11 November, after the Android crash fix and two days of review.
Uncertain: Friday 6 November only if the crash is fixed by Wednesday, otherwise the week after.

plantedMismatches.note: Sarcasm: Nadia takes 'Sure, Friday' as a commitment; Theo meant it isn't realistic; Ruben treats it as conditional.

stated: Ruben: "I'll prep the store listing either way."
confirmed: Version 3 is submitted for review on Monday 2026-11-09 and released by Wednesday 2026-11-11; Nadia moves the store feature to that weekend.

precise.text: Version 3 is submitted for review on Monday 2026-11-09 and released by Wednesday 2026-11-11. Nadia asks marketing to move the store feature one week.

vague.text: We'll try for Friday and see how it goes.
